description.text: This course is only taught by Chinese and students should have basic knowledge of Chinese to study this program.

duration.text: The Arts Studies at Wuhan University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4305 USD/per year ￥ 31000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents Undergraduate school transcript

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, who haven’t broken laws, are required to have bachelor degree.
